slides.lead: Most founder "interviews" are sales pitches in disguise. Here's how to actually learn something.

slides.h2: Ask what they did, not what they'd do.
slides.lead: "Would you use this?" gets polite yeses. "When did this last happen to you?" gets the truth.

slides.h2: Look for the hack they use today.
slides.lead: A messy group chat. A notice board. A spreadsheet. A workaround means the pain is real.

slides.h2: Let them do most of the talking.
slides.lead: Every minute you spend explaining your app is a minute you're not learning.
Arguing wins the conversation and loses the insight.

slides.h2: End with "who else should I talk to?"
slides.lead: One conversation turns into three. That's how you find your first users.

slides.h2: Your users already know what to build.
